name: labs/steiva__opentrons-ot2-http-python-wrapper
title: Opentrons OT-2 (HTTP wrapper)
intro: Opentrons OT-2 (HTTP wrapper), adapted from steiva/opentrons-ot2-http-python-wrapper. It reads `robot_model` and `run_count`; runs `aspirate`, `dispense`, `create_run`, `load_pipette` and 4 more. `aspirate`: draw a specified volume of liquid from a declared labware well into a pipette tip, with a bounded flow rate and an optional liquid-level offset. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
